ITEM TEXT
By
the
1820 s
Bentham
had
become
a
well
-
known
figure
,
both
in
Britain
and
in
other
parts
of
the
world
.
His
ideas
were
to
influence
the
reforms
of
public
administration
made
during
the
nineteenth
century
,
and
his
writings
are
still
at
the
centre
of
academic
debate
,
especially
regarding
social
policy
,
legal
positivism
,
and
welfare
economics
.
Bentham
died
on
6
June
1832
,
a
day
before
the
first
Reform
Act
was
given
Royal
Assent
.
As
per
the
directions
in
his
will
,
Bentham's
body
was
dissected
by
his
friend
,
the
surgeon
Thomas
Southwood
Smith
,
and
his
skeleton
preserved
as
the
Auto
-
Icon
.
Research
into
Bentham's
thought
and
life
continues
today
at
UCL's
Bentham
Project
,
set
up
in
the
early
1960 s
with
the
aim
of
producing
the
first
scholarly
edition
of
his
works
and
correspondence
.
This
edition
is
projected
to
run
to
some
eighty
volumes
.
Members
of
the
public
are
invited
to
assist
in
this
massive
editorial
task
by
helping
to
transcribe
Bentham's
manuscripts
via
Transcribe
Bentham
.
